definitions.gloss: to brew, to make (tea or coffee)
definitions.explanation: To prepare tea or coffee by pouring hot water over leaves or grounds. This kanji specifically refers to the process of brewing a beverage, as distinct from the general verb {入|い}れる (to put in).

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}は{必|かなら}ず{紅茶|こうちゃ}を{淹|い}れて{飲|の}む。
examples.english: I always brew and drink black tea in the morning.

examples.japanese: {丁寧|ていねい}に{淹|い}れたお{茶|ちゃ}は{香|かお}りが{違|ちが}う。
examples.english: Tea that is carefully brewed has a different aroma.

notes:
USAGE:
The kanji {淹|い} specifically means to brew by steeping or pouring hot water. In practice, お{茶|ちゃ}を{入|い}れる (using the simpler kanji) is also very common and accepted. Using {淹|い}れる signals a more deliberate focus on the brewing process itself.

Applies to tea ({緑茶|りょくちゃ}, {紅茶|こうちゃ}, etc.) and coffee. Not used for other beverages.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{茶|ちゃ}を{淹|い}れる: to brew tea
- コーヒーを{淹|い}れる: to brew coffee
- {丁寧|ていねい}に{淹|い}れる: to brew carefully
- {淹|い}れたて: freshly brewed
